news.title: Trump weighing options to strike Iran's critical oil hub, UN Ambassador Waltz says
news.description: Israel says it has killed two senior Iranian intelligence officials as oil loading reportedly resumes in the UAE's Fujairah port following a fire.

news.title: U.S. and China economic chiefs meet in Paris to clear path to Trump-Xi summit
news.description: Trade analysts said that with Washington's focus on the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran, prospects for a major trade breakthrough are limited.

news.title: Price caps, taking the stairs, and short-sleeved shirts: How countries are coping with the Iran war energy shock
news.description: Some countries have imposed price caps and released oil stockpiles to maintain energy supplies, while others are trying to reduce consumption.
